title: Unreal Raspberry Blue Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Unreal Raspberry’s ‘Blue’ is quite possibly Blue Raspberry flavour in its purest, most delicious form. Rich blueberries and tangy-sweet raspberries combine to make a mouth-watering flavour that almost impossible to resist. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
